content.short: Furion is an NFT liquidity platform enabling users to swap and collateralize NFTs fractionally.
content.description: Furion is an NFT liquidity platform where users can swap and collateralize NFTs fractionally. The platform creates separate and aggregated liquidity pools and supports long- and short-term NFT futures and derivatives. Users can receive F-X tokens as ERC-20 mirrors that can be traded in Furion pools or AMM trading pairs, backed by NFTs. FUR is the native token and veFUR is the governance token.
